name: The Fragments Within
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The moonwell water has revealed that embedded inside the crystal are a few small fragments of bone, as well as half of a jawbone.  The jawbone appears to be from a humanoid, but it is unclear without breaking open the crystal - a feat that even the strongest of magic would find near impossible.

With the task at hand complete, all that remains is to report back to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
narrative.objectives: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well, it would seem that even though we know more about this crystal, more unanswered questions are the result!

I'll take the information you've uncovered to the council here in Auberdine. Perhaps they'll know a course of action to follow on this crystal. Well, that is if there is one to be taken; for now, the threat remains far enough to our east to be out of harm's way.

As for you, please have this. Consider it a reward for a job well done, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 14, 1,955 XP in all.

quests.name: The Red Crystal
quests.objectiveText: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range.

quests.name: As Water Cascades
quests.objectiveText: Fill the Empty Water Tube at the Auberdine moonwell, and then investigate the red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall.

quests.name: The Fragments Within
quests.objectiveText: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
